rationale: C11 is an especially strong reusable drafting template: it predates the child by less than a month and shares the same three-recital sequence, including the exact formulation that the dispute threatens to deprive “a section of the country” of essential transportation service. It then uses the same operative sequence and nearly verbatim language for the thirty-day report and section 10 status-quo requirement, with only the carrier, employee representative, and date changed. C03 and C01 are also near-verbatim templates, but their recital refers to a “large section” rather than the child’s and C11’s exact “a section.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the International Longshoremen's Association, A.F. of L., a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Boston & Albany Railroad Company (New York Central R.R. Company, Lessee), a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The opening recital has the same syntax and legal-role structure, with the disputing carrier and labor organization substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The two substantive predicate recitals are verbatim, including the comparatively specific phrase “a section of the country.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The first operative provision is identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Boston & Albany Railroad Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The second operative provision reproduces the same statutory machinery and language, changing only the named carrier.
